recommendations: PII is the #1 risk: KYC documents, government IDs, bank details, emails are REAL. Encrypt at rest, restrict access, implement retention policies.
Rate limiting is in-memory only — replace with Redis/DB-backed store before any real traffic.
Audit logging is console.log — replace with persistent, tamper-evident audit trail for compliance.
Storage bucket policies need tightening — KYC documents should not be publicly accessible.
Add CSP, HSTS, and security headers before production.
Implement proper secrets management (Doppler, Vault, or at minimum env validation).
Add monitoring/alerting (Sentry, LogRocket) — currently flying blind.
2FA is implemented but recovery codes are stored — verify they are hashed (they are: codeHash).
Email system is custom SMTP — consider transactional email service (Resend/Postmark) for reliability.
No CI/CD pipeline — add automated testing and deployment before production.
